keySentence: Dorothy wanted to go home more than anything.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy was in a strange and colorful land. She saw many amazing things around her. But she did not feel happy. She felt very sad. Dorothy wanted to go home more than anything.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy traveled through the magical Land of Oz with her new friends. She saw the Emerald City shining in the distance. Everything was wonderful and exciting, but her heart ached for home. No beautiful sight could make her forget Kansas. Dorothy wanted to go home more than anything in the world.
